findings.section: Build a workflow-based shortlist — illustrative example
findings.reason: The example treats a feature’s availability through a separate paid service as the reason to mark it “claimed but not shown.” A separate charge does not establish whether the feature was demonstrated.
findings.action: State explicitly that the feature was not demonstrated, and record the separate charge as a cost issue. Otherwise, assign the status based on what the team actually saw.

summary: The page covers the assigned evaluation workflow and uses the supplied sources appropriately. Revise the shortlist example so its status follows the stated scoring rule. No FAQ was assigned or included.
